description: PGP key check — Decode and audit an OpenPGP (GPG) public key: fingerprint, key ID, algorithm/bits/curve, user IDs and emails, subkeys, usage flags, expiry, revocation, cipher/hash preferences. Self-signatures and subkey bindings are cryptographically verified (RSA, Ed25519, ECDSA). Flags RSA<2048, DSA, v3 keys, SHA-1 self-signatures, expired/revoked/expiring keys, no encryption subkey, no expiry, tampered blocks (bad signature or armor CRC). Verdict OK/REVIEW/WEAK/EXPIRED/REVOKED. pubkey= ASCII-armored key (URL-encode it), or url= (e.g. https://github.com/USER.gpg or https://keys.openpgp.org/vks/v1/by-email/EMAIL). Private keys are refused. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
